# mhcp

`mhcp` provides tools for simulation, probability calibration,
and effective-dimension analysis for the multiplicative
half-Cauchy process.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/mhcp")
```

## Simulation

```r
library(mhcp)

set.seed(123)

x <- rmhcp(
  n = 5,
  d = 20,
  zeta = 0.7
)

x
```

## Probability calibration

Choose `zeta` so that

\[
P(\eta_{10} \le 0.05)=0.90.
\]

```r
calibrate_mhcp(
  H = 10,
  epsilon = 0.05,
  p = 0.90
)
```

This gives approximately

```text
zeta = 0.369
```

## Local flexibility

```r
mhcp_excursion_prob(
  zeta = 0.7,
  c = c(1, 2, 5)
)
```

## Effective dimension

```r
expected_mhcp_dimension(
  zeta = 0.369,
  epsilon = 0.05
)
```
